text: Airtable - Composio Toolkit | Composio All Toolkits Airtable AIRTABLE Latest version 20261116_00 Airtable merges spreadsheet functionality with database power, enabling teams to organize projects, track tasks, and collaborate through customizable views, automation, and integrations for data management Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth available OAuth2 API Key Frequently Asked Questions How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Airtable? Use your own Airtable OAuth integration when you want users to see your app's name on the consent screen and control the credentials yourself. Create the Airtable OAuth integration Sign in to Airtable and open the Airtable developer hub . In the left menu, under Guide , click OAuth integrations , then click + New OAuth Integration in the top-right corner. Enter a name and description. The website field is optional. Users see these details when they authorize your app. Under Redirect URLs , add https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add . It must exactly match the oauth_redirect_uri field in your Composio auth config, with https and no trailing slash. Save the integration and copy the Client ID and Client Secret . Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Airtable . Set the authentication type to OAuth2 and choose Use your own developer authentication . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret , then click Create Airtable Auth Config . Click Connect Account . On the Airtable consent screen, select the bases or workspaces to grant and click Approve . Confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. Scopes The default auth config requests data.records:read , data.records:write , data.recordComments:read , data.recordComments:write , schema.bases:read , schema.bases:write , and user.email:read . Change the Scopes field on the auth config if your integration needs fewer. If the connection fails, check that the redirect URL in Airtable matches the auth config's oauth_redirect_uri exactly.
